reason: It's free and it kills my Discord-plus-some-reader-site shuffle — the thing remembers where I stopped and the chat sits right next to the series I'm actually reading, which nothing in my setup does now.
objection: I've watched group projects die in two weeks — if nobody else in the chat actually posts there, I'm just reading alone in another empty tab I'll forget I ever opened.
would_change_my_mind: If the group chat actually moves over — real messages and links in there for a couple of weeks instead of Discord — I'd stop juggling and stay; if it's dead by week two I'm gone anyway.
